newsitem.headline: TABLE -SAFECO sells two-tranche debt deal.

text.p: The following two-tranche 144a debt issue from SAFECO Corp was priced Thursday via Smith Barney, according to market sources.

SAFECO Corp, based in Seattle, Washington is engaged through its subsidiaries in property/casualty insurance, life and health insurance, surety, real estate investment and management, and commercial credit and asset management.
